findings.claim: TablesList now uses the stub NewInMemoryDB(), whose RunCommands returns a generic 'not implemented' error. Upstream code reports this as 'invalid SQL' / sql-invalid-sql, so valid SQL expressions fail with a validation error instead of an explicit 'disabled' error.

verifier.reason: pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:23-29 calls NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands, whose stub in pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16-18 always returns errors.New("not implemented"). On the default buildCMDNode path (pkg/expr/nodes.go:159-160, when FlagExpressionParser is off), UnmarshalSQLCommand calls NewSQLCommand (pkg/expr/sql_command.go:30-36), which logs "invalid sql query" and returns errutil.BadRequest("sql-invalid-sql", ...) for any TablesList error instead of a disabled/not-implemented error.
